items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Well you made that thing with Sam I was just telling you about.

ctx.x: nothing else. But they said they did, they said they had us in a picture, I don't know. Of course if we know that we could have got paid for it, that's when I didn't believe it.
Have you made any records since you've been back here? Not here, no. Not any real band records or anything? No. Well you made that thing with Sam I was just telling you about.

Well yeah, but I didn't know anything about that, so Sam got to let me know something about that. But I'm really planning on if I get a little more strength making something like that, because I got some good stuff, I'll sell it all out, I'll do something with it. But of course I've got to wait a little while, yet I'm trying to rush myself up a little too fast. I've just got to wait a while.
